consumer: The frontend map renderer that paints item sprites/symbols per tile; it asks 'what items physically lie on each nearby ground tile?' fed by arcopolis_export reading map::i_at(p) over the export window.
scope: Ground-item stacks across the nearby map region (the export window of tiles around the avatar), not the character's carried/crafting inventory.
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_entities(items) iterates points_in_radius around the avatar, reads each tile's map::i_at(p) ground stack, and serializes the raw per-tile item state (type_id, name, symbol, charges) as entities.items[].
divergence: Avatar carries a knife in inventory but no knife lies on any nearby ground tile: a possession/inventory authority (mission crafting_inventory or u_has_item) reports the knife present, yet the correct ground render must paint NO knife on any tile — exposing the wrong authority.
